title: Liv Bike Tour with Alfredo rocked!
text: Alfredo was a wonderful guide and companion. He want the "extra mile" to make our time enjoyable, right down to introducing us to his favorite bakery and dessert (Hofman, marscopane croissant). Thank you Liv Tours and Alfredo.
author: petew215

title: Alfredo was awesome! Beautiful tour and perfect amount of time!
text: My husband and I thought this tour was great and so worth it! We learned so much about Barcelona and had fun doing it! Saw so many amazing sites we didn’t even know about. Alfredo was awesome and felt like a friend right away. He was also an amazing photographer:)
author: mariahp789

title: Wonderful private tour with Montse
text: My private tour with Montse of Barcelona Gaudi highlights was absolutely wonderful. Montse was passionate and very knowledgeable.  She was a great teacher, storyteller and guide offering background, details and insight at each site visited.  The symbolism she explained at Sagrada Família was superb and made the visit truly meaningful.  I opted for a private tour with a driver as I only had one day in Barcelona.  The driver, Ramon, was also excellent, very friendly, professional and accommodating.  While the private tour and driver were pricey, I felt it was worth every penny, being a solo trav
author: SusieC123

title: A great way to see and learn about Barcelona
text: Alfredo was knowledgeable and insightful about Barcelona and all of Spain. From culture to history to sights, he was a wealth of knowledge. We had a great tour and would recommend him to anyone without hesitation!

title: 5 Stars

title: So wonderful!
text:
I highly recommend doing a bike tour with Alfredo! It was such a great way to see the city, and was so fun! Alfredo really loves what he does, and you can tell. He is part historian, part comedian, and just full of heart. We loved Alfredo so much that we requested him for our tour the following day.
 Liv Tours is a wonderful company and so accommodating. We chose them for all four of our tours here in Barcelona, and we are very happy we did!
